newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro RSCG wins Haagen-Dazs Europe account.
newsitem.headline: Euro RSCG wins Haagen-Dazs Europe account.

text.p: French advertising agency Euro RSCG, a subsidiary of Havas, said on Wednesday it won the European advertising account for Haagen-Dazs ice cream.
It said in a statement it was working on a pan-European campaign which would be launched before the end of this year. A spokeswoman at Euro RSCG declined to say how much the account was worth.

Advertising for Haagen-Dazs, one of the major brands belonging to Britain's Grand Metropolitan Plc, was for six years handled by British agency Bartle Bogle Hegarty (BBH), which declined to re-pitch for Haagen-Dazs's European account.
Euro RSCG said it would create a single image for Haagen-Dazs across Europe, "based on the phenomenal success which the brand has experienced during the last seven years."
The campaign will focus on the ice cream brand as a top choice and on its quality image, Euro RSCG said.

"The new campaign will be built on the strength of the brand, its personality and its reputation in the premium segment in order to create an environment favourable to its future growth and to consolidate its leadership position," Euro RSCG said.

The campaign will be developed by Euro RSCG Wnek Gosper in London and will be adapted by Euro RSCG's Gregoire Blachere Huard Roussel and Lagon agencies in France, Euro RSCG Madrid in Spain and Euro RSCG Dusseldorf in Germany, it said.
